summary: Sagtec Global Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting a definitive private subscription agreement with Director/CEO/major shareholder Ng Chen Lok for 1,500,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$1.04/share, totaling US$1,560,000. The price was based on market price as of June 17, 2026. Shares are newly issued, rank pari passu with existing shares, are restricted securities with no registration rights, and proceeds will fund working capital, corporate purposes, strategic initiatives, and expansion. The transaction closed June 17, 2026. This non-US filing reports a private placement to an insider; the small size and insider nature suggest a capital raise rather than a broader special situation, but classification is low confidence.
